ops.title: explain serve: bound draining when an active response stalls
ops.description:
Owner: desk-roll-on-install implementation caller.
Review scope: staged diff; source inspection only; no tests run.
Severity: major
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lr/internal/explain/explain.go:504 — Shutdown receives cmd.Context, which remains live on a roll, and the server has no write deadline. A client that stops reading a sufficiently large static response can keep Shutdown and the receive at line 508 blocked forever after the listener has closed.
Next executable step: Give response writes or the shutdown drain a finite bound and close residual connections after expiry.

ops.text: A stalled response cannot permanently prevent launchd relaunch after a promotion.
A normal in-flight response finishes during graceful shutdown.
